correctness.rationale: For nonempty proper k-subset I⊂[n], its normal projected to H_n has norm sqrt(k(n−k)/n) and common barycenter slack k(n−k)/2, yielding distance d_k=(1/2)sqrt(n k(n−k)). The minimum is r_n=sqrt(n(n−1))/2, attained only for k=1,n−1. Perm and Asso retain all singleton facets; summing their center-to-singleton distances gives any inscribed radius at most r_n and forces uniform center at equality. Para retains the parallel x1=1,n supporting hyperplanes of width 2r_n. Its full max-center set is exactly the independent prefix bounds lower≤p_i≤upper; i=1,n−1 intervals collapse while middle i=2..n−2 have positive widths, dimension n−3 if n≥4. Contact facets and n=2,3 edge cases follow from k endpoints. All-dimensional derivation independently reconstructed; small n arithmetic corroborates rather than proves.
